payload.text: **hv, 27 Oct, in intent-ic's session (relayed verbatim by intent-ic, 11:26Z): Intent's build all and intentd restart go ahead once judge run 3 is green and lands, ahead of L1's close.** intent-ic asked: "Your call: when run 3 is green and lands, should vc run `build all` and restart the daemon at once, ahead of molt-vc's L1 word?" hv: "Unequivocally Yes." This lifts, for this one install, decision 22's freeze on Intent's installed build, which was molt-vc's reading and not hv's words. On the desk the build is one heavy (heavy, cargo), granted when no run whose gate calls intent is in flight. Gtools' next landing first runs its own `land.sh --check` against the new install.
